dataset: Per-record outputs of HELM Classic release v0.4.0 (Stanford CRFM): every run whose method is multiple_choice_separate_original or multiple_choice_separate_calibrated. Only run names, instance ids, option indices, classes, counts and public model names are published.
note: exact_match and predicted_index are HELM's recorded per-record values. frac: exact_match not 0 or 1 (current HELM tie rule); old_tie: exact_match 1 but predicted_index (first top-scoring option) not correct (HELM v0.2.2 tie rule); F = 1 iff predicted_index is correct (first-argmax binary, the fix proposed in HELM issue #4363 / PR #4364). Headline = mean over unperturbed records (all trials, or the first trial when only that reproduces HELM). P2 >= 1 tie; P3 old_tie >= 1 and frac == 0; P4 ties <= 1% of records; P5 the 3 models with most ties hold >= 50%; P6 some run's headline moves >= 0.01; P7 >= 50% of ties are in instances where a wrong option repeats a correct option's text.
